Sam (CSM): Heads-up — CrossPlay flagged activation of 3 new product squads. They'll flip traffic next Monday. We've seen a ~3x QPS spike in staging over the last 48h. Need provisioning guidance and an enablement for their platform engineers.

Maya (Customer Success): Nice, quick Qs — account id? expected steady QPS vs burst? model mix?

Sam (CSM): account: crossplay-prod-302. Staging spike: baseline ~250 QPS -> ~750 QPS during tests. Prod expectation: start ~500 QPS with bursts up to ~1200 QPS. Primary workloads: text-generation (conversational) + embeddings for semantic search.

AJ (Solutions Eng): Good signal. Can we confirm model profiles (sizes / seq length)? That changes batching/quantization recommendations and whether Dedicated makes sense.

Leo (SRE): FYI ops-bot already flagged sustained token/sec increase. @Sam please paste the route config (or sample traffic) so I can run a quick capacity sim.

ops-bot: [auto] Alert: route crossplay-prod-302 exceeded expected tokens/sec threshold (staging) — 48h sustained. See https://console.redwood.ai/alerts/AC-302

Sam (CSM): Pasting a simplified route snippet they used in staging: ```routes:
- name: crossplay-search
  model: open-llama-34b
  endpoints: [us-west-2]
  batching: dynamic
  max_seq: 1024
  cache_prefix: true```

Maya (Customer Success): I'll schedule enablement Thu 10am PT with their infra + app teams. AJ + Leo can you join? I'll send calendar invite and a pre-read.

AJ (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a short pre-read: recommended model variants (quantized 4-bit where safe), batching & prefix-cache settings, canary rollout plan, and code snippets for their infra. Draft doc link once ready.

Leo (SRE): Quick capacity takeaways in the meantime: if steady prod stays <=600 QPS, hosted with aggressive batching + KV caching should be fine. If they sustain >800 QPS or need consistent low-p95 latency, recommend a short Dedicated pilot with reserved burst slots. Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with SLIs: p95 latency, 5m error rate, token cost.

Sam (CSM): I'll ask CrossPlay for a 24h traffic trace and sample payloads. Expecting that by EOD. Will drop it in #customer-data once received.

Maya (Customer Success): FYI — potential expansion / renewal signal: if this goes well they'll likely ask for committed capacity and enterprise contract. Flagging AE for follow-up.

AJ (Solutions Eng): Can someone confirm the model/seq distribution? e.g., 90% short (<=256 tokens) for chat + 10% long (>=512) for embeddings/long summaries. That changes GPU selection and kernel paths. Also will prepare a cost delta estimate: 500 qps vs 1000 qps for hosted vs Dedicated.

Leo (SRE): Also requesting a short test plan: latency SLOs they'd accept, acceptable error budget, and a rollback trigger. Sam, can you collect that during enablement?

Sam (CSM): Yep — will collect SLOs and rollback criteria in the session. I'll also confirm who the infra owner is to add to the invite.

Maya (Customer Success): :eyes: Please add any customer contacts and org map to the invite — helps AE + Solutions prep.

AJ (Solutions Eng): Draft pre-read uploaded here (private): https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/crossplay-onboard-1 — will iterate and share final before Thu.

ops-bot: [auto] Notice: Scheduled meeting created by Maya (Customer Success) — Thu 10:00 PT.

Leo (SRE): After the trace is in I can run a capacity sim and share recommended CPU/GPU profile + batching knobs. If anyone wants to experiment with quantized variants, ping me and I'll spin a quick benchmark.

Sam (CSM): Thanks team. I'll post the trace and the contact list ASAP. :thumbsup:

Maya (Customer Success): Thanks — see you Thu.

AJ (Solutions Eng): Will have cost estimates and pre-read updates before EOD Wed.

Leo (SRE): Copy — will stand by for the trace and the canary run plan.

Sam (CSM): closing loop — adding AE on thread once I have the renewal signal confirmed.
